requirements.proposition_to_establish: A system of controls is in place to manage hygiene at the property or establishment.
requirements.criterion_quote: the system of controls to manage hygiene

query_sources.quote: the system of controls to manage hygiene

there must be a system of controls in place at the property in relation to those operations, and the plants or plant products for which the property is to be accredited, to ensure that the conditions prescribed by sections 3-3A and 3-3B will be complied with

There must be a system of controls in place at the establishment in relation to the export operations and the plants or plant products for which the establishment is to be registered to ensure that the conditions prescribed by sections 4-7A and 4-7B and, if applicable, section 4-8A will be complied with
